proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ d s h2 hs hns
  have tn : ∀ a b : ℚ, Algebra.trace ℚ K (algebraMap ℚ K a + algebraMap ℚ K b * s) = 2 * a := by
    intro a b
    have hli : LinearIndependent ℚ ![(1 : K), s] := by
      rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
      intro c e hce
      by_cases he : e = 0
      · subst he; simp at hce; exact ⟨hce, rfl⟩
      · exfalso
        apply hns
        refine ⟨-c / e, ?_⟩
        have : (e : ℚ) • s = -(c • (1 : K)) := by
          have := hce; rw [add_comm] at this; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left this
        have he' : algebraMap ℚ K e ≠ 0 := by simpa using he
        rw [map_div₀, map_neg, div_eq_iff he', mul_comm]
        simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using this.symm
    let B : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℚ K := basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank hli (by simp [h2])
    have hB0 : B 0 = 1 := by simp [B]
    have hB1 : B 1 = s := by simp [B]
    let x : K := algebraMap ℚ K a + algebraMap ℚ K b * s
    have e0 : x * B 0 = a • B 0 + b • B 1 := by
      simp [x, hB0, hB1, Algebra.smul_def]
    have e1 : x * B 1 = (b * d) • B 0 + a • B 1 := by
      simp only [x, hB0, hB1, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, add_mul, mul_one]
      rw [mul_assoc, hs]; ring
    have hM : Algebra.leftMulMatrix B x = !![a, b * d; b, a] := by
      ext i j
      rw [Algebra.leftMulMatrix_eq_repr_mul]
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
      · simp [e0]
      · simp [e1]
      · simp [e0]
      · simp [e1]
    change Algebra.trace ℚ K x = _
    rw [Algebra.trace_eq_matrix_trace B, hM, Matrix.trace_fin_two]; simp; ring
  have t1 : Algebra.trace ℚ K 1 = 2 := by simpa using tn 1 0
  have ts : Algebra.trace ℚ K s = 0 := by simpa using tn 0 1
  have tss : Algebra.trace ℚ K (s * s) = 2 * d := by rw [hs]; simpa using tn d 0
  have tw : Algebra.trace ℚ K ((1 + s) / 2) = 1 := by
    have := tn (1 / 2) (1 / 2)
    rw [show algebraMap ℚ K (1 / 2) + algebraMap ℚ K (1 / 2) * s = (1 + s) / 2 by simp; ring] at this
    simpa using this
  have tww : Algebra.trace ℚ K (((1 + s) / 2) * ((1 + s) / 2)) = (1 + d) / 2 := by
    have := tn ((1 + d) / 4) (1 / 2)
    rw [show algebraMap ℚ K ((1 + d) / 4) + algebraMap ℚ K (1 / 2) * s = ((1 + s) / 2) * ((1 + s) / 2) by
      have : (((1 + s) / 2) * ((1 + s) / 2) : K) = (1 + 2 * s + s * s) / 4 := by ring
      rw [this, hs]; simp; ring] at this
    rw [this]; ring
  constructor
  · rw [Algebra.discr_def, Matrix.det_fin_two]
    simp [Algebra.traceMatrix_apply, Algebra.traceForm_apply, t1, ts, tss]
    ring
  · rw [Algebra.discr_def, Matrix.det_fin_two]
    simp only [Algebra.traceMatrix_apply, Algebra.traceForm_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, mul_one, one_mul, t1, tw, tww]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (d : ℚ) (s : K), Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 → s * s = algebraMap ℚ K d → s ∉ Set.range (algebraMap ℚ K) → Algebra.discr ℚ ![(1 : K), s] = 4 * d ∧ Algebra.discr ℚ ![(1 : K), (1 + s) / 2] = d
